roleTitle: Registered Nurse (RN) - Staff Development & Infection Control
description: Join a dedicated team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Oakland, MD, as a Staff Development Coordinator and Infection Control Nurse. This vital role offers an opportunity to significantly impact patient care and staff competency within a supportive environment.In this dual capacity, you will be responsible for developing and implementing comprehensive staff education programs, ensuring our team is equipped with the latest skills and knowledge. Concurrently, you will lead our infection prevention and control initiatives, safeguarding the health and well-being of both residents and staff by adhering to best practices and regulatory standards.We are seeking a passionate and experienced Registered Nurse to fill this full-time position, offering a competitive hourly rate. If you are ready to make a difference and contribute to a culture of excellence, we encourage you to apply.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Maryland
Experience in staff development and education
Experience in infection prevention and control practices
Knowledge of state and federal healthcare regulations
salaryOrBonusInfo: Hourly rate of $40.00 - $42.00, based on experience.
